message: My account was accessed by someone else. Account hacked.
I see an unauthorized charge on my statement.
I was charged twice for one order.
An unknown device signed in and changed my password.
Where is the receipt for my order?
How do I change the shipping address?
Mera account hack ho gaya, madad chahiye.
Ek order ke do baar paisay kat gaye.
Meri ijazat ke baghair payment hui.
Order ki receipt kahan milay gi?
Mera account hack ho gaya tha? Nahi, sirf sign-in ka tareeqa pooch raha hoon.
Kya delivery kal ho sakti hai?
میرا اکاؤنٹ ہیک ہو گیا ہے۔
ایک آرڈر کے دو بار پيسے كٹ گئے۔
میرے کارڈ سے بلا اجازت ادائیگی ہوئی۔
مجھے اپنا پتہ تبدیل کرنا ہے۔
